name: Small Jar with Three Loop Handles and Ascending Lotus-Petal Decor
summary: The walls of this small, ovoid jar rise at a steep angle from the circular footring, expanding to the widest point at the shoulder, where they angle inward to form the virtually flat shoulder; a short, circular neck echoes the short, vertical footring. Three equally spaced, loop rings enliven the shoulder, overlapping shoulder and neck.
